[h3]Q1: How did the experience of "Contract Girlfriend" come about? Is it related to the male protagonist? [/h3]
That's natural! Because there are too few men in the town, it is similar to the daughter country (?)
And "you" were targeted on the first day you came to the town. [strike]<(｀^′)>You guys should protect yourself[/strike]
